channel.title: Find Me A M?ori Bride
channel.desc: NEW: You'd think a chance to score a $47,000 inheritance would get the average maori's A into G. But not Ponsonby based property developer Tama Bradleyand accountant George Alpert are ... how should we say it ... not the sharpest naihi in your average marae kitchen. Luckily for our tane the unexpected arrival of a long lost cousin - Elizabeth Partridge means they'll get a second crack at their nanny's land. This is going to be an epic winner takes all battle putting wahine against wahine. There'll be no escape from the madness, from the double and triple crosses, and ultimately from our tane finding true love.
